data.name: Welehola
data.detailed_description:
Enter the Halls of Welehola!

Step into the shoes of a wizarding student to learn the arcane arts in a magical academy! What sort of witching student life would you live? Would you harness the power of the elements and become a wizard hotshot? Go out on daring-do adventures in an old castle, overgrown grounds or wilderness older than time? Put on the witchiest outfits and head to the village inn? What would your very own mage’s dormitory look like? Welehola is your chance to show your marvelous colors!

Live in Magical Academia

  • Cozy up next to a fireplace in your own nook, decorated to your taste 

  • Study with style and wear what strikes your fancy

  • Take part in lessons to learn the ropes or just go out and experiment, the choice is yours!

  • Meet a diverse cast of truly unique characters in magic classes, extracurricular activities and clubs or get together in the nearby villages.

  • Spend time with your companions and maybe even find a partner in love!

In Welehola, design your dorm and collect or craft unique outfits to match your style. Learn about the world through the personal stories of a varied cast of fellow students, teachers and stranger denizens of the surrounding mountain valley.

Harness the Elements

  • Wield and mix the elements to create wild combinations. The world of Welehola is your magical playground!

  • Craft items - from mundane to absolutely enchanting, with customizable crafting stations

  • Cultivate crops and grow exotic plants for your alchemical experiments

  • Brew potions with fun cauldron mechanics

  • Cast fireballs and move like the wind!

Welehola is powered by an intuitive mix-and-match magic system that branches out to all core gameplay loops. Crafting, brewing, combat and even dialogue options are impacted by the powers you wield. As you shape the elements to your will, the elements shape you.

Explore the Ancient North

  • Face the dangers of a mysterious wilderness

  • Create spells to tackle varied challenges

  • With clever spellcraft exploit enemy weaknesses, take advantage of your surroundings and avoid environmental hazards

If the stone walls of the castle, the roots of the great guardian tree or the evergreens of the Wildlands could speak, the air would be filled with whispers of secrets, history and lost knowledge. The world of Welehola invites you to delve deeper, rewarding exploration at every turn!

Unravel the Mystery

  • Fix the broken down castle and campus

  • Find out what lurks in the far reaches of the Wildlands

  • Solve a mystery of the ancient world

  • Make your own way - yours is the story that matters the most!

In the far north, inside a giant rowan tree is the home of the Boreal Academy of Welehola: Sanctuary of Mystical Arts and Arcane Wisdom in the Arctic Realms. If the Welehola campus grows too small, you’re free to seek the secrets hidden in the Wildlands looming at the doorstep of the academy. The world of Welehola is rich with history and legend, taking inspiration from classical and contemporary works of fantasy, with a unique Nordic bend.

Embark with Friends!

  • Play with up to four buddies

  • Share the adventures and collaborate to restore Welehola

  • Get together to meet the toughest challenges the Wildlands have to offer

Fun is best shared, and Welehola too will include the option for a player to host a game, where up to four players may join forces in building, exploring and living out their wizarding life fantasies!

Wishlist & Follow!

Wishlist now to be among the first to uncover the secrets of Welehola and follow us to stay in the loop for future updates!

Welehola YouTube

Welehola is still in early development.
